newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsukoshi to disband units, sell facilities.
newsitem.headline: Mitsukoshi to disband units, sell facilities.

text.p: Department store operator Mitsukoshi Ltd said on Friday it would sell two distribution centres in Japan to a subsidiary and would dissolve three wholly owned units.
It said in a statement that it would make a profit of about 7.2 billion yen by selling its distribution centres in Tokyo and Sapporo in late February to its distribution unit in Tokyo.
It also said it would liquidate a financial unit in the Netherlands, which would produce a profit of about 400 million yen.
Mitsukoshi said it would also disband a Tokyo-based sports club operator and car sales unit facing business difficulties as part of its efforts to strengthen its financial health.
The dissolution of the two Tokyo units would result in a loss of 6.7 billion yen, it said.

Mitsukoshi said earlier on Friday that it had lowered its parent current profit forecast for the year to February 28 to nine billion yen from its previous forecast of 9.3 billion yen and its net profit forecast to three billion yen from an earlier forecast of 3.2 billion yen.
The lowering of the forecasts was due to unexpectedly sluggish sales, especially in the second half of 1996/97, due to dampened consumer confidence, it said.
